description: This Java class defines step definitions for testing business date functionalities in the Fineract project, including setting and verifying business dates via API calls, and handling error scenarios.

classes.name: BusinessDateStepDef
classes.description: Step definitions class for managing business date related test scenarios, utilizing Cucumber annotations.

methods.name: setBusinessDate
methods.description: Sets the business date to a specified value.

methods.name: setBusinessDateToday
methods.description: Sets the business date to the current date.

methods.name: checkBusinessDate
methods.description: Verifies that the business date is correctly set to the specified date.

methods.name: setIncorrectBusinessDateFailure
methods.description: Attempts to set an invalid business date and expects an error response.

methods.name: setNullOrEmptyBusinessDateFailure
methods.description: Attempts to set null or empty business date value and verifies error handling.
